43/G.goal: Explain how to implement an XR system using prototypes and how to evaluate those prototypes through expert-based usability evaluation methods.
43/G.achieves: Prepares the learner to move from system design to implementation in the course's XR system case study by building, evaluating, and refining prototypes to develop the system with confidence.

43/O1.goal: Describe how to use prototypes in system implementation by classifying throwaway, incremental, and evolutionary prototypes.
43/O1.achieves: Enables the learner to choose a prototype strategy that fits the implementation stage and supports subsequent design and development decisions.

43/O2.goal: Conduct expert-based prototype evaluations by planning evaluation sessions, following task scenarios, and checking designs against usability heuristics to identify and report usability issues.
43/O2.achieves: Gives the learner a practical way to assess and refine XR system prototypes during implementation, supporting design decisions before more extensive development.
